answer: Require each agent to post a bond locked in a public contract, then slash it if the agent’s actions fail a randomly selected, independently verifiable task. A newcomer can earn higher limits only after completing tasks over time, so creating a hundred identities does not multiply influence: each needs its own funded bond and track record. The lantern dashboard shows pending bonds, the marble ledger records slashes, and a vine of referrals grants no extra weight. The attacker pays capital costs, risks forfeiture, and must sustain distinct useful behavior.
